item.title: A Portrait That Listens to My Spotify and Judges Your Browser
item.description: If you open the home page now, the portrait doesn’t just sit there anymore. It says hi, then puts on whatever the song I’m listening to deserves, then takes a good look at you and tells you what it thinks. Then it does the Omarchy bit it always did. Every couple of seconds, by itself.
